Step.Text: Note: Action names in fmIDE can be specified in any way you want - independently of how the action is passed: - `Go to Layout` (Original/natural case - recommended) - `go_to_layout` (lower_snake_case) - `GoToLayout` (UpperCamelCase) - `Go To Layout` (Title Case) - `GO TO LAYOUT` (UPPERCASE) The first style, Original case, is the recommended format, being identical to FileMaker step names The second style, lower_snake_case, is like all other fmIDE parameter names, so is also good The third style, UpperCamelCase, is how the action is identified in the script The final two are just capitalisation variants of the original case …but you can choose whatever suits you!

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: About fmIDE `hard pauses` and `continuations` (in order to access the Custom Function Dialog):

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: - Some FileMaker dialogs, notably the custom function dialog, are not scriptable and can only be opened when no script is running.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: - This requires fmIDE to exit the script before opening the custom functions dialog, and then continue from where it left off afterwards

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: - fmIDE supports such 'hard pauses' via a `continuation`, which works like this:

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: 1. The entire fmIDE running state is packed into a continuation object 2. Using MBS a delayed keyboard press or menu call is triggered to open the Custom Functions 3. Using MBS a delayed restart of the fmIDE script is scheduled passing the continuation state via the "continuation" parameter 4. The Script then exits - The Custom Functions dialog is opened - The user does his work in the CF Dialog - The user closes the CF dialog - The MBS Schedule calls the fmIDE script passing the "continuation" parameter 5. The Script is restarted by the MBS Schedule, all state variables are reinstated from the `continuation` parameter - and the MBS Schedue is reset - using the saved $$fmide__continuation_mbs_schedule_ref value

Step.Text: # Vars defined at this point ## Public Vars `$fmide_version `$fmide_dialog_title `$fmide_actions ## Private Vars ### Parameter vars - `$fmide__jsp`: JSON Script Parameter - `$fmide__jsp_type`: The type of parameter format that `$fmide__jsp` has - `$fmide__jsp_keys`: The list of keys that `$fmide__jsp` contains / or a JSON `?…` error - `$fmide__parameter_names_all`: List of all possible parameter names - `$fmide__parameter_names_found`: List of found parameters names ### Environment vars - `$fmide__is_mac`: 1 if on a mac - `$fmide__is_mbs`: 1 if the MBS plugin is present - `$fmide__is_win`: 1 if on windows - `$fmide__mbs_remote_control_press_command_or_control_key`: The key for MBS to use when controlling the keyboard - `$fmide__original_layout_number`: The number of the original layout for the `Go to Original Layout` action - `$fmide__original_window_name`: The name of the original window for the `Go to Original Window` action ### fmIDE Action Script Interpreter state - `$fmide__action_index`: loop variable / index into the `$fmide_actions array / 'action pointer' - `$fmide__action_index_max`: loop variable / length of the `$fmide_actions array / 'action pointer' exclusive maximum value - `$fmide__action_line`: FIXME: What is? - `$fmide__action_block`: inside blocks = the name of the action that started the current block - `$fmide__action_skip`: Defines what to skip: - `If`: Skip the current `If`/`Else If` section - `End If`: Skip to the next `End If` step, because an `If`/`ElseIf` section is completed - `{block}`: Skip everything in the rest of the block, that is, until the stack is popped off - `$fmide__action_stack`: The stack controlling the execution depth and logic - contains action_stack frame objects each having the following information - `block`: The name of the action that started the block - `index`: The action index identifying the line in the action array - `skip`: 1 = skip - `$fmide__action_stack_top`: Pointer to the top of the action stack - `$fmide__actions_string`: FIXME: What is? - `$fmide__local_variables`: A list of variables defined with the `Set` action - `$fmide__continuation`: 1 = hiatus + continuation - `$fmide__continuation_seconds`: Number of seconds before the hiatus continues ### Temporary variables - `$fmide__i`: Loop variable - `$fmide__n`: Loop variable length - `$fmide__r`: (MBS) result variable
